identityReview: Mexican former president Andrés Manuel López Obrador, commonly AMLO. Birth date supported by the Electoral Tribunal’s explicit finding. Morena founder status does not establish a current party executive position. Former presidency ends on 30 September 2024; do not confuse his son Andrés Manuel López Beltrán with him.
lifeStatusEvidence: El Financiero reported a written public condolence communication on 28 October 2026. This is evidence of a reported recent message, not verified physical attendance or a health assessment. November birthday greetings alone are not used as proof of appearance. No direct inspection of the original social-media post or audiovisual material is claimed.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read official electoral ruling, INE-hosted candidate PDF and registration resolution; CIDOB biography and update; International IDEA policy analysis; official judicial decree and Reuters reporting; El Financiero recent-message report; museum biography and Commons metadata. UNAM degree date was available only as an explicit indexed primary-source extract, with direct access failures recorded.
corrections: Read the Electoral Tribunal determination dated 8 August 2018 in the DOF, especially eligibility paragraphs 130–134 and final declarations. It explicitly confirms birth on 13 November 1953, election victory, the Morena/PT/PES coalition and constitutional term from 1 December 2018 through 30 September 2024. The certified birth-record finding is not a separate inspection of the original birth certificate. Do not infer blanket personal probity from the eligibility discussion.

Read CIDOB political biography and its succession update. Main narrative is dated 29 November 2018; update names Claudia Sheinbaum as successor on 1 October 2024. Distinguish handover from legal final day, and do not treat the old main text as a current office record. Earlier PRD leadership, Federal District office and unsuccessful 2006/2012 campaigns are corroborated. Self-proclaimed legitimate presidency was not constitutional office. Charged editorial descriptions and the apparent 2008 heading typo are not adopted.

Read the search-indexed UNAM-DGCS-440 extract explicitly confirming a licenciatura in Ciencias Políticas y Administración Pública on 12 November 1987 after university requirements were met. Direct opens failed with 502/timeouts, so this is an indexed primary-source extract, not a complete bulletin inspection. Both display text and review preserve that limit. Do not confuse 1970s study dates with degree award or call it a doctorate.

Read the two-page 2018 INE-hosted candidate submission, including the career section. It distinguishes Morena movement formation in 2011, national council presidency in 2012, party registration in 2014 and executive committee presidency from 2015. It is candidate-supplied material; allegations of election fraud and campaign promises are not presented as adjudicated facts or completed achievements.

Read the Electoral Tribunal-hosted INE resolution, antecedent III and quoted first operative provision of INE/CG94/2014. Registration was approved on 9 July 2014 with constitutive effect on 1 August. These are separate dates and neither is substituted for the earlier movement formation.

Read International IDEA retrospective government-performance section, including cash transfers and real minimum-wage growth. It assesses economic results as mixed and attributes a contribution to poverty reduction to these policies. This is an attributed analytical assessment, not proof of exclusive personal causation. Different poverty measures and periods are not conflated; no numeric poverty series is reproduced.

Read the official judicial reform decree, its publication/signature date and first two transitional provisions. The decree was issued on 15 September 2024 and entered into force the following day. Publication is neither immediate entry into force nor a completed judicial election. The legal change is distinguished from political claims about its benefits or risks.

Read Reuters reporting syndicated on Investing.com, including paragraphs on López Obrador’s stated rationale and critics’ concern about judicial political independence. Both remain attributed views. The report says the reform took effect on Sunday; the primary decree’s next-day clause controls the dossier date instead. No independent validation of either side’s predictions is claimed.

Read El Financiero’s 28 October 2026 report, including the quoted condolence message attributed to López Obrador following Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas’s death. This supports a reported written public communication after leaving office, not an in-person appearance, health assessment or inspection of his original social-media account.

Read the one-page Museo de los Presidentes Coahuilenses biography. Earlier PRD and Federal District roles and 1 December 2018 inauguration corroborate other sources. Its claimed 14 October 2024 presidential end date is erroneous against the electoral ruling and succession record; its stray 1797–1867 line is unrelated. Its 1973–1976 parenthetical cannot establish the degree award date. These errors are explicitly excluded.

additionalConsulted.access: Search excerpt read; direct open returned 403. Birthday greeting is not used as appearance evidence and book claims were not independently checked.
Search excerpt of archived 2018–2024 presidential biography only. Its partisan account of the 2006 dispute was not adopted as an adjudicated finding.

sourceReview.limits: UNAM bulletin was read only through its indexed extract. Policy analysis is selective, not a complete evaluation of the administration. Latest adopted activity is a reported social-media message of 28 October 2026, not an in-person appearance. Source image metadata is readable but original image download and visual inspection remain blocked.

portraitReview.unresolved: Read Commons description, author, explicit CC BY-SA 4.0 license and crop history. Description identifies a 24 June 2020 press conference at Palacio del Ayuntamiento; current 1274×1810 revision is dated 9 January 2022. The unrelated Spanish caption requesting hurricane assistance is not identity evidence. EXIF shorthand CC BY does not replace the explicit file license. Preserve attribution, crop/change notice and share-alike terms. Original download on 18 November 2026 failed with curl 22, proxy HTTP 403 and reported HTTP 000; old research cache is absent. Full original bytes, identity, colour and crop suitability remain uninspected.

translationReview.scope: 32 display fields in each of seven foreign languages checked against Chinese and English. Preserve former office, constitutional term end versus handover, decree publication versus next-day effect, movement formation versus party registration, indexed education evidence, attributed policy assessments and message publication versus physical appearance. Original influence object unchanged.
